data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'odele', meaning 'wealthy one'. In Greek mythology, Odele was the name of a nymph who protected the forests and mountains. In Christianity, Odele represents the spiritual wealth gained through faith and devotion. The name Odele carries the meaning “Wealthy one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Odele usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Odele represents the spiritual wealth gained through faith and devotion. Odele serves as an inspiration for those seeking to enrich their spirituals lives with faith, love, and inner peace.
